review.evidence: Native issuance is a USDat share wrapper with an observed five-day upgrade controller and one-hour parameter timelock. The current implementation, USDat asset, share supply, totalAssets and default-admin membership were re-observed at Ethereum block 26108096. Public custody/assurance prose remains on the legacy STRC structure, while the deployed vault holds STRCon. The unresolved review preserves observed adverse/local powers without asserting a complete safe control inventory or scoreable whole financial claim. Native proxy genesis-to-pin RoleGranted/RoleRevoked replay (17 events), joined to current exact implementation role constants and current hasRole checks, resolves {"DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE":["0xfd5782e3bff366601da3973ae30c583de4f08a67"],"OPERATOR_ROLE":["0xc35580434261f667d6abbda9e3dc1dc31e5a1b92"],"BLACKLISTER_ROLE":["0xf5a93281ac8604f99755cc489317e75ac334cfe2"],"ENFORCER_ROLE":["0x6f72de4f529a03bfa883825152656a8c62cbb626"],"PARAMETER_MANAGER_ROLE":["0x6f72de4f529a03bfa883825152656a8c62cbb626"],"PAUSER_ROLE":["0xf5a93281ac8604f99755cc489317e75ac334cfe2"],"UNPAUSER_ROLE":["0x6f72de4f529a03bfa883825152656a8c62cbb626"],"SURPLUS_MANAGER_ROLE":["0xc35580434261f667d6abbda9e3dc1dc31e5a1b92"],"MARKET_MODE_MANAGER_ROLE":["0xc35580434261f667d6abbda9e3dc1dc31e5a1b92"]}. Default-admin timelock: sole proposer/canceller 0x610182581c93687ca03f4a8e7f124f8cec616820, open EXECUTOR_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN held only by itself, delay 432000. Parameter timelock: sole proposer/canceller 0x7a5a4064005584bc727666ec82548a9139d5f21e, open executor, self-only default admin, delay 3600. Both proposers and current operator are code-empty addresses; no Safe quorum is inferred. The official Fireblocks 2/3 disclosure covers listed Admin/Compliance/Processor/Asset-Cap wallets, but does not establish MPC custody for new V2 operator 0xc35580434261f667d6abbda9e3dc1dc31e5a1b92 or parameter proposer. Upgrade authority can replace native mint logic; no fixed non-raiseable issuance bound is established. Downloaded audits: Three Sigma 30 Dec 2025–12 Jan 2026; Certora 16–23 Jan 2026; Certora M0 review 23–27 Feb 2026; Certora M0/FV 23 Feb–9 Apr 2026; Certora sUSDat V2 27 Jul–5 Aug 2026 covers vault, queue, STRCon module/oracle/execution policy at commits 4157ff8/f9bb4f9, but the PDF is marked DRAFT. No report is financial assurance or proves identity with the deployed September build. Calibration 2026-10-03: non-census disclosure observations retained outside the umbrella mint-path flag: What signed/MPC policy and operational independence control the V2 operator 0xc35580434261f667d6abbda9e3dc1dc31e5a1b92 and parameter timelock proposer 0x7a5a4064005584bc727666ec82548a9139d5f21e? The older Fireblocks wallet roster does not bind these addresses. What executed legal and independent financial reconciliation constrains recognized STRCon NAV against sUSDat liabilities after the migration? The public code audits, including a V2 draft, are not financial assurance.
